ph.title: Contact number and email
ph.p: The contact number is only for the courier to call; change or clear it without a code.
ph.same: This is already your contact number.
ph.again: Verification timed out — ask for a new code.
em.p: We send a code to the new email. After the change, your other devices are signed out and earlier orders stay in your account.
em.link: Connect an email to your account
em.link.p: Sign-in is by email only. Connect an email with a code to keep your account and orders.
em.send: Send code to the new email
em.sent: Code sent to the new email.
em.same: This is already your account's email.
err.email_taken: This email has its own account. To use it, sign out here and sign in with that email.
